    - P<weeks>W (e.g., P2W)

import re

def iso_duration_seconds(s):
    """
    Convert ISO 8601 duration string to seconds.
    Accepted forms:
    - P<weeks>W (e.g., P2W)
    - P[<days>D][T[<hours>H][<minutes>M][<seconds>S]] with at least one count present
      If T is present, at least one of H, M, S must follow.
      Time components (H, M, S) can ONLY appear after T.
    """
    if not s or not s.startswith('P'):
        raise ValueError("Invalid duration string")
    
    # Check for week-only format: P<digits>W
    week_match = re.fullmatch(r'P(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)W', s)
    if week_match:
        weeks = float(week_match.group(1))
        return weeks * 7 * 86400
    
    # Check for day/time format with T: P[<days>D]T[<hours>H][<minutes>M][<seconds>S]
    with_t_match = re.fullmatch(r'P(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)D)?T(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)H)?(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)M)?(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)S)?', s)
    if with_t_match:
        days_str, hours_str, minutes_str, seconds_str = with_t_match.groups()
        
        # At least one of H, M, S must be present
        if all(x is None for x in [hours_str, minutes_str, seconds_str]):
            raise ValueError("T must be followed by at least one of H, M, S")
        
        total_seconds = 0.0
        if days_str is not None:
            total_seconds += float(days_str) * 86400
        if hours_str is not None:
            total_seconds += float(hours_str) * 3600
        if minutes_str is not None:
            total_seconds += float(minutes_str) * 60
        if seconds_str is not None:
            total_seconds += float(seconds_str)
        return total_seconds
    
    # Check for day-only format (no T): P[<days>D]
    no_t_match = re.fullmatch(r'P(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)D)?', s)
    if no_t_match:
        days_str = no_t_match.group(1)
        if days_str is None:
            raise ValueError("At least one count must be present")
        return float(days_str) * 86400
    
    raise ValueError("Invalid duration string")
